description: Collect remote tech and IT job listings from Jobicy. Search by keyword, region, industry, employment type, seniority, salary, company, or posting date; look up specific jobs by ID, slug, or URL; check job status; or export the filter taxonomies.

companies.description: Keep only jobs from these companies (case-insensitive exact names). Leave empty for all companies.
companies.title: Companies

geo.description: Jobs open to this region or country. Use 'Anywhere' for roles open worldwide.
enumTitles: Malaysia (mapped to APAC + Malaysia location filter)
geo.title: Region

includeDescription.description: Include the full job description as clean plain text. Turn off for lighter records.
includeDescription.sectionDescription: Control record size and which optional fields are included.
includeDescription.title: Include full description

includeDescriptionHtml.description: Also include the original HTML description. Only applies when full descriptions are enabled.
includeDescriptionHtml.title: Include HTML description

includeNoSalary.description: When a salary, currency, or period filter is set, also keep jobs that do not disclose pay.
includeNoSalary.title: Include jobs without salary

industry.description: Jobicy category, such as Software Engineering, Data Science & Analytics, or Marketing & Sales.
industry.title: Industry

jobIds.description: For mode=getJobs: numeric IDs, slugs, or Jobicy job URLs. For mode=getJobStatus: numeric IDs (or slugs/URLs with a numeric prefix).
jobIds.sectionDescription: Use these fields for getJobs and getJobStatus. The feed only covers jobs from the last 7 days.
jobIds.title: Job IDs, slugs, or URLs

jobTypes.description: Keep jobs matching any selected employment type. Leave empty for all types.
jobTypes.title: Employment types

levels.description: Keep jobs matching any selected seniority level. Leave empty for all levels. Jobs tagged 'Any' are only returned when no level is selected.
levels.title: Seniority levels

locationContains.description: Extra text filter on the displayed location after fetching, for example 'USA' or 'Germany'. Leave empty for all locations.
locationContains.title: Location text contains

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to save. Jobicy publishes roughly 1,400 jobs in its 7-day window.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxSalary.description: Keep jobs whose effective salary lower bound is at most this number. Set salary currency and period for an exact comparison.
maxSalary.title: Maximum salary

minSalary.description: Keep jobs whose effective salary upper bound is at least this number. Set salary currency and period for an exact comparison.
minSalary.title: Minimum salary

mode.description: What to collect: search the live feed, look up specific jobs, check whether stored jobs are still open, or export the filter taxonomies.
enumTitles: Get specific jobs by ID, slug, or URL
Get specific jobs (legacy alias for Get jobs)
mode.sectionDescription: Search the live Jobicy feed, retrieve known jobs, check status, or list the available regions and industries.
mode.title: Mode

postedSince.description: ISO date or timestamp, for example 2026-11-20. The Jobicy feed covers the last 7 days.
postedSince.title: Posted on or after

postedUntil.description: ISO date or timestamp, for example 2026-11-22.
postedUntil.title: Posted on or before

query.description: Text searched across Jobicy job content, for example 'python developer', 'react', or 'customer success'. Use 2-50 characters. Multiple words are matched together.
query.sectionDescription: Narrow the feed with Jobicy's server-side region, industry, and keyword filters, then refine the results below.
query.title: Search keyword or tag

salaryCurrency.description: Only compare salaries in this currency. Leave empty to compare the source numbers as-is.
salaryCurrency.title: Salary currency

salaryPeriod.description: Only compare salaries with this pay period. Leave empty to compare the source numbers as-is.
salaryPeriod.title: Salary period

taxonomyType.description: For mode=getFilterOptions: export locations, industries, or both.
taxonomyType.title: Taxonomy to export

title: Jobicy Remote Tech & IT Jobs Scraper Input
